assessments.reasoning: Bytes [3246,4386) contain the operative waiver, including the holder, the connection between rights and claims, and the applicable-law qualification. Its broad geographic and temporal terms are consistent with those limits. Section 4(a) also expressly reserves the Affirmer's patent and trademark rights.

challenge.method: Assume the Affirmer owns the text of a work, another person owns an illustration, and local law restricts waiver of one of the Affirmer's rights. Test the worldwide wording against each limit.
challenge.results: The introduction limits the Affirmer's election to the extent of ownership. Section 1 describes possible rights without assigning ownership. The waiver therefore reaches the Affirmer's rights in the text only as far as law permits. The illustrator's rights and claims remain outside that surrender. Section 3 anticipates that some of the waiver may be ineffective.

limitations: Ownership of a particular right and the extent to which applicable law permits its waiver require separate evidence.
reasoning: Section 2 identifies the Affirmer as the holder of the rights surrendered and links the claims and causes of action to those rights in the Work. It covers existing and future claims, including unknown ones. Applicable law sets the ceiling on the waiver.
